{{dablink|For other uses of the word "blue," see [[Blue]].}}
The '''''Blue Crane''''' is a ship that travels on the [[River Erinin]].

== Activities ==
[[Egwene al'Vere]], [[Elayne Trakand]], and [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] traveled on this ship from [[Tar Valon]]. They intended to take the ship all the way to the city of [[Tear]], but the ''Blue Crane'' ran upon mud flats six miles north of [[Jurene]].{{ref/book|3|37}}  The ship is still hung up when Egwene, Elyane and Nynaeve board the ''[[Darter]]'' at [[Jurene]].{{ref/book|3|39}} 

The day before [[Mat]] and [[Thom]] (aboard the ''[[Gray Gull]]'') arrive at [[Aringill]], they passed a ship stuck on a mudbank which Captain [[Huan Mallia|Mallia]] would not stop to help.{{ref/book|3|40}} [[Rahvin#Gaebril|Rahvin's]] men later find the ship at Aringill long after the three [[Accepted]] had left it.{{ref/book|3|46}}
